jobs.description:
Xensam: Join the Future of SAM Xensam is the leader in AI-powered, cloud-based Software Asset Management. Our technology brings clarity to complex IT environments, helping users make smart, data-driven decisions and maximize software ROI.
Recognized with the Highest Growth Award and ranked #3 Overall Champion at the Main Software 50 Awards Nordics, we’re scaling fast and looking for people who want to join the journey. At Xensam, you play a key role in a team built on energy, focus, and positivity. We value experience, but even more, the person behind it.
Together, we build the future of SAM. 
About the role
As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring the success and satisfaction of our enterprise clients. You will work closely with them to understand their business needs, implement effective strategies, and provide ongoing support to ensure they achieve their desired outcomes. Your goal is to foster strong, long-term relationships and drive customer retention and growth.
Responsibilities

Act as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, building trusted advisor relationships.

Conduct regular check-ins and Business Reviews to ensure customers are satisfied and achieving their goals.

Lead the onboarding process for new enterprise customers, ensuring a smooth transition and successful implementation of our products/services.

Address and resolve customer concerns promptly, escalating issues when necessary.

Renew accounts to enhance customer retention with timely management.

Gather feedback through surveys and product usage data, identifying trends to share with internal teams.

Represent customers’ needs and success stories to drive customer-centric improvements across the company.

Keep educational, power points and self-service resources up-to-date.

Anticipate customer needs by analyzing usage patterns, engagement metrics, and feedback.

Manage and update customer information in the CRM system, ensuring data accuracy and tracking all customer interactions. Use the CRM to monitor customer health, manage tasks, and maintain a clear view of the customer lifecycle.

Qualifications 

5+ years of experience working B2B as an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, Key Account Manager or Senior Customer Success Manager.

Experience with support tools and platforms like HubSpot.

Excellent presentation and organizational skills.

An innovative self leader that is service minded.

Proficiency in languages like German, and Dutch is a plus.

Experience in the field of SaaS is a requirement.

Fluency in both written and spoken English and Swedish.

What you get

A generous work culture with free drinks and snacks, office massages, and more.

Three days in-office (with remote work on Mondays and Fridays).

An opportunity to shape your career growth while contributing to the company’s success.

A dynamic position embracing "freedom under responsibility".

If sales targets are met, all employees enjoy an annual destination trip.

Other location-specific benefits.

Our values at Xensam
Rebellious We challenge the norm and act with initiative – always with responsibility.
Humane We foster a caring, inclusive environment that values diversity and respects individuality.
Harmony We value balance and create a supportive workplace where people thrive.
As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on final candidates to fulfill our commitments to customers and ensure a safe work environment.

jobs.occupation: Fire and Auxiliary system commissioning Engineer
jobs.description:
At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is to advance a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals, and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that make a real impact on our communities and society. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation.
HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) is a product group within Hitachi Energy that develops, manufactures, and sells DC transmission systems globally. HVDC technology is used to transmit electricity over long distances, via submarine cables, and to connect power systems.
The Auxiliary Commissioning team is a global team within the HVDC Construction and Commissioning division. The team consists of commissioning engineers specializing in auxiliary systems such as auxiliary power, HVAC/climate systems, fire protection, and other building services. We are a diverse, multicultural team working closely across disciplines – and we look forward to you joining us.
This is a role with extensive international travel opportunities.
In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring that fire protection systems are safely commissioned and fully operational in HVDC projects worldwide.
Your responsibilities
Commissioning of fire detection and fire protection systems
Signal interface testing of fire panels
Preparing test instructions and related documentation
Cost estimation for fire system commissioning
Collaboration with fire system suppliers and contractors
Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business

Your background
Minimum 5 years of experience in commissioning fire systems
Experience with VESDA systems within the high voltage industry is considered an advantage
CFPA or NFPA certification is considered an advantage
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience within mechanical, electrical, fire engineering, or building services
Experience in other auxiliary systems (e.g. auxiliary power, HVAC) is considered an advantage
Strong communication skills in English
A team player who enjoys collaborating across disciplines
Willingness and flexibility to travel extensively worldwide, sometimes on short notice
Due to the international nature of the role and extended assignments outside Sweden, you have the unrestricted ability to travel and work across Europe for longer periods

What we offer
• Collective agreement
• Flexible working time
• Health care and wellness allowance
• Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy both within Sweden and globally
• Mentor to support you throughout onboard phase
• Various trainings and education supporting employee development
• Diversified company with over 70+ nationalities working in Sweden
• Supplementary compensation for parental leave
• Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks
More about us
Are you ready to join Hitachi Energy for a career without limits and a place where you can be yourself? We are ready for you. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply today.
Hiring Manager, Saliya-Bandara Tennakoon (saliya-bandara.tennakoon@hitachienergy.com), will answer your questions about the position.
Union representatives: Sveriges Ingenjörer: Mikael Hjort, +46 107-38 29 86; Unionen: Fredrik Holmgren, +46 107-38 21 85; Ledarna: Frank Hollstedt, +46 10 738 7043.
For other questions, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Johanna Davidsson Drakou (johanna.davidsson-drakou@hitachienergy.com).

Join us in building Stockholm’s new metro and play a key role in one of Sweden’s largest infrastructure projects.
Are you an experienced mechanic who enjoys hands-on work, troubleshooting technical equipment, and working in a dynamic site environment? We are looking for a skilled and motivated Mechanic to join our team and help ensure the reliability and performance of our equipment and machinery.
Main Responsibilities as a Mechanic
As a Mechanic, you will be responsible for servicing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing a wide range of equipment used in tunneling and construction operations. The role combines mechanical maintenance with welding and steel fabrication work to support daily operations and minimize downtime.
Key Responsibilities
Service, maintenance, and repair of tunnel machines and associated equipment.
Preventive and corrective maintenance of site vehicles, site cars, pumps, generators, and other machinery.
Troubleshooting and fault-finding on mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems.
Welding, steel fabrication, and repair work as required.
Inspection of equipment to ensure safe and efficient operation.
Replacement of worn or damaged components.
Documentation of maintenance activities and repair records.
Support operational teams with technical expertise and rapid response to breakdowns.
Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with safety procedures and company standards.

Qualifications and Experience
We are looking for candidates who have:
Relevant mechanical or technical education, or equivalent work experience.
Experience in maintenance and repair of heavy equipment, construction machinery, industrial equipment, or vehicles.
Good knowledge of mechanical systems, hydraulics, and pneumatics.
Practical experience in welding and steelwork.
Ability to read and understand technical drawings and manuals
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
A valid driver's license (Category B)

The following are considered an advantage:
Experience working in tunneling, mining, construction, or infrastructure projects.
Knowledge of diesel engines and hydraulic systems.
Welding certifications.
Experience with heavy construction equipment and pumps.

Personal Qualities
You are a reliable and safety-conscious team player who takes pride in delivering high-quality work. You work independently when required, have a proactive attitude, and thrive in a fast-paced operational environment.
What We Offer
As an international company, we offer a truly global environment, reflected in both our offices and projects. You will have many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from different parts of the world, supporting both your personal and professional growth. We are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and offer a wellness allowance.
Information and Application
Please submit your CV and cover letter in English. If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Itinera’s HR department at Hrsweden@itineraspa.se.
If Itinera and the Mechanic position sound like the right opportunity for you, we encourage you to apply today. The application deadline is 19 December 2026, but please note that we review applications on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the closing date.
About Itinera S.p.A.
We are an international construction company with roots in Italy, specializing in large-scale infrastructure and civil engineering projects for more than 80 years. Established in 1938, the company is part of the ASTM Group, operating in over 15 countries with 14,000 employees.
In Stockholm, we are currently working on the extension of the metro lines at Hammarby Kanal station, Södra Hagalund, and Arenastaden. We have also constructed the new Skurubron in Nacka.
Our Swedish headquarters are in Solna, and we currently employ more than 300 people.
We have chosen to handle this recruitment internally; advertising salespersons or external recruiters are kindly declined.

jobs.occupation: Front-end Developer to Swedbank’s Group AI Accelerator
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for creating modern, intuitive and accessible digital experiences, and want to advance AI capabilities at a leading bank in the Nordics and Baltics?

In Swedbank you have the opportunity to:
Design, develop, test and continuously improve modern applications using Angular and TypeScript, including accessible and responsive AI-powered experiences across web and mobile channels.

Translate business needs and UX/UI designs into scalable, high-performing solutions, collaborating with designers, product owners, platform engineers and backend developers.

Integrate frontend applications with APIs, backend services and AI capabilities.

Drive engineering excellence through reusable components, code reviews, automated testing, secure development, performance optimization and accessibility standards.

Take ownership from implementation to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement, while contributing to CI/CD, documentation and knowledge sharing.

Collaborate closely with data engineers, software engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver AI solutions

Ensure solutions are built with security, compliance, and governance in mind.

Continuously develop your skills through mentorship, training and workshops and by working on diverse projects that push technological boundaries.

Be part of an innovative team that values creativity, diversity, inclusion, and fosters an environment where new ideas are encouraged. 

What is needed in this role:
Proven experience with Angular, TypeScript, HTML and CSS, together with strong knowledge of responsive design, WCAG accessibility and user-centered design.

Experience integrating frontend applications with RESTful APIs and applying best practices for automated testing, code quality, performance, maintainability and security.

A growth mindset — motivated to explore frontier AI developments, stay updated on AI trends, and apply learnings to real-world challenges.

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. 

With us, you can experience:
Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.

Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.

An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.

A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.

Enjoy country-specific benefits, including banking offers, a pension plan, our share-based reward program, health insurance in the Baltics and a health allowance in Sweden.

"Join our team and...
become part of Group AI Accelerator, an international and cross-functional team combining frontend excellence, AI enablement and platform innovation. Together, we create intuitive, accessible and secure digital experiences that contribute to Swedbank’s digital transformation and position in society." -Emelie Gustavsson, your future manager 
We look forward to receiving your application by 04.12.2026. 
Location: Umeå or Stockholm
Recruiting manager: Emelie Gustavsson +46725394117 
We may begin the selection during the application period, so we welcome your application as soon as possible.
We would like to let you know that a background check and a drug test may be a part of the process for this role.
We have made our choice regarding recruitment media and therefore kindly decline contact with ad sellers or sellers of other recruitment services.
Swedbank does not discriminate anybody based on gender, age, sexual orientation or sexual identity, ethnicity, religion or disability – everybody is welcome.

jobs.occupation: Advance Your Orthopaedic Career in Coastal Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Dignus Medical collaborates with several established healthcare providers across Sweden. We are currently receiving ongoing requests from hospitals in central Sweden seeking specialist physicians in orthopaedics. These opportunities arise regularly as healthcare providers expand their orthopaedic services and strengthen their specialist teams.
We are continuously interested in connecting with Orthopaedic Surgeons who are open to exploring professional opportunities in Sweden.
The Role
As a specialist in orthopaedics, you will work in a modern hospital environment alongside multidisciplinary teams focused on high-quality patient care. The clinical work typically includes both elective orthopaedic surgery and acute trauma care, depending on the structure of the department.
Common responsibilities include:
Assessment and treatment of musculoskeletal disorders and injuries
Elective orthopaedic procedures depending on experience and subspecialty
Participation in trauma and emergency orthopaedic care
Outpatient consultations and follow-up care
Collaboration with physiotherapists, radiologists, and other medical specialists
Participation in clinical development and quality improvement work

Hospitals in this region often manage a broad orthopaedic case mix, offering opportunities to work with both common orthopaedic conditions and more complex cases.
Location and Lifestyle
The opportunities are located in a region of central Sweden known for its coastal landscapes, forests, rivers, and open countryside. The area offers excellent access to nature and outdoor activities year-round, including hiking, fishing, skiing, and boating.
Daily life is practical and well-organized. Cities in this region offer short commuting distances, accessible housing, and well-developed public services. Schools, childcare, and healthcare services are easily available, making the region suitable both for individuals relocating alone and for physicians moving with their families.
The lifestyle combines a calm environment with reliable infrastructure and convenient travel connections to larger Swedish cities.
Qualifications
EU-recognized specialist certification in Orthopaedics
Solid clinical experience in orthopaedic practice
Experience in trauma care and elective orthopaedic procedures is beneficial
Ability to work independently while collaborating in multidisciplinary teams
Good communication skills in English
Willingness to learn Swedish

What Dignus Medical Offers You
Ongoing support from a dedicated recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required
Help with accommodation and travel arrangements, including support for your family, if necessary
Access to a free language course with a private tutor

Why Choose Dignus Medical?
We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.
Interested in learning more?
Contact us to learn more about current and upcoming opportunities for orthopaedic specialists in Sweden, or submit your application today. Dignus Medical looks forward to helping you explore the next step in your career.
We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Pediatric Ophthalmologist Wanted for Leading University Hospital
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Join a leading University Hospital in Southwestern Sweden!
Are you a pediatric ophthalmologist from the EU looking to grow your career in a modern, academic, and supportive environment?
A leading university hospital in southwestern Sweden is now recruiting specialists in pediatric ophthalmology to strengthen its highly specialized eye care department. This is an exciting opportunity to work with advanced diagnostics and nationally designated care for pediatric glaucoma and cataract, while contributing to education, clinical development, and research within one of Sweden’s foremost ophthalmology units.
About the role
You will join a large ophthalmology department with more than 250 professionals, covering outpatient care, emergency eye services, inpatient wards, and surgical units. The pediatric ophthalmology section provides comprehensive diagnostic and therapeutic care for children and collaborates closely with electrophysiology and hereditary disease units.
You will work in multidisciplinary teams that include physicians, orthoptists, nurses, optometrists, and technicians, all focused on delivering patient-centered, high-quality eye care. As part of a university hospital, you will also have the opportunity to participate in teaching, clinical research, and innovation projects.
Requirements
EU-recognized specialist certification in ophthalmology
Minimum five years of clinical experience in ophthalmology
Focus and competence in pediatric ophthalmology
Strong interest in teaching, research, and clinical development
Good communication skills in English and willingness to learn Swedish
Team-oriented, responsible, and committed to providing high-quality patient care
Experience or competence in medical retina is considered an advantage

Language and relocation support
A willingness and motivation to learn Swedish is important for your integration and clinical work.
The relocation process begins once you reach language level B2. During this stage, you will work 50% clinically and study 50% Swedish until you achieve C1 level, which is required to apply for a Swedish specialist license (specialistbevis) to practice as a specialist doctor.
Language training is provided free of charge once you have accepted an employment offer.
You will receive full support throughout the licensing and relocation process, including assistance with documentation, Swedish authorization, and settling in Sweden.

What Dignus Medical offers you
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required
Help with accommodation and relocation, including support for your family
Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Why work in southwestern Sweden?
Live and work in one of Sweden’s most beautiful and dynamic regions, combining city life, culture, and nature.
Enjoy a high quality of life with short commutes, clean air, and a safe, family-friendly environment.
You’ll have time for both professional development and personal wellbeing.

Ready to take the next step in your career?
We look forward to supporting your move to Sweden and helping you continue your professional journey as a pediatric ophthalmologist. Contact us for more information, or apply today!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

The Supply chain and Procurement Manager supports the entire lifecycle of our enzyme-based solutions—from procuring raw materials and components to delivering the final product to the customer. This expanded role consolidates the entire end-to-end supply chain, giving you single-point accountability for spend management, inventory health, distribution efficiency, and daily business operations.
The role
We are seeking an agile and strategic Supply chain and Procurement Manager to lead our supply chain from start to finish, from the suppliers we buy from, through our contract manufacturers, to the customers who receive our products. In this multifaceted role, supporting our product line director and the overall company activity, you will be responsible for procuring highly specific materials related to enzymes and biomanufacturing, managing day-to-day activities with existing raw material suppliers and production facility, supporting cost-saving procurement strategies, and optimizing logistics networks. You will also oversee daily warehouse, fulfilment, international shipping and business workflows to maximise productivity and efficiency. The ideal candidate is a master of cross-functional execution who balances hands-on operational ownership and a higher-level picture of supply chain and process efficiency oversight.
You will choose and negotiate with suppliers, plan materials for each CMO campaign, keep inventory accurate across our sites and arrange shipments that arrive on time and comply with regulations. When costs rise, stock runs low or a delivery slips, you will spot it early, bring the right people together and drive it to a solution. This is a hands-on role with plenty of room to build the function your way as we grow.

Key Responsibilities
Manage the purchasing of raw materials, from request to delivery.
Identify and qualify new suppliers and CMOs in collaboration with the Product Line Director 
Develop and maintain the supply base, focusing on quality, delivery and cost efficiency.
Establish and update agreements with key suppliers and CMOs, including pricing and purchase terms.
Plan and coordinate material supply for production campaigns at our CMOs, and follow up on timelines.
Monitor inventory levels to secure material availability while avoiding excess stock.
Coordinate inbound and outbound shipments, and ensure compliance with import/export regulations.
Follow up on spend against budget and drive cost-saving initiatives as needed.
Streamline daily operations and improve processes for ordering, receiving and shipping. 

Who you are
Required
A university degree in supply chain management, logistics, industrial engineering or similar.
At least 5 years of experience in production planning, supply chain or procurement within the manufacturing industry, specialty chemicals, cosmetics, food or a similar industry.
Experience from driving cross-functional collaboration, improvement work and process development.
Excellent English skills, both spoken and written

Nice to have
Experience navigating global trade tariffs, customs clearance protocols, and international sourcing networks.
Proven ability to operate as subject matter expert in a company building its operations function.
Experience in a scale-up moving from R&D to pilot or commercial production, including technology transfer to CMOs.

 
What we offer
A people-driven, forward-looking company of 30+ people from more than 15 nationalities;
A fast-moving, collaborative and multidisciplinary team shaping the future of industrial biotech;
A start-up environment with minimal red tape, real responsibility and ownership, and room to learn and grow;
A competitive salary and wellness grant;
25 days of paid annual leave plus bridge days, occupational health and injury insurance, and an occupational pension plan mirroring ITP-1.

About the job
As a Engineering Consultant focusing on Materials Engineering within Surface Materials at Condesign Engineering, you work on exciting assignments at some of the world’s leading technology companies. Together, we identify customer assignments with our many customers that interest, challenge and motivate you in an environment where you can both thrive and grow. As a consultant, you can work on different assignments over time, and you get valuable career development.
We are growing and are now in need of additional talented employees.
About the role, Role description:
Condesign is seeking a Materials Engineer that will be working with surface materials within the automotive industry. You will be part of the product development and work with both internal stakeholder as well as with external suppliers to refine and develop different types of surface materials for various projects. Project management and coordination, supplier management and interaction, reading and reviewing test reports, colour measurement together with decision making is a big part of the work. 
Travels to national and international suppliers will most likely be part of the role.
Your Profile and Required skills:
Engineering Background
Master of Science in Materials Engineering, preferably focusing on Surface Materials
Automotive industry experience
Surface materials and surface treatment experience (vinyl, leather, textile, plastic, paintwork/clear coat)
Colour measurement experience
Test reports creation and test reports interpretation for decision making and approvals
Project management & coordination skills
Supplier Management
Familiar with Agile way of working
Fluent in English, both spoken and written. Swedish is meritorious.
Driver’s license B
Willing to travel for supplier visits. 

Desired skills:
Experience in supplier manufacturing environment
Material lab environment experience
Experience in Konica Minolta Spectra Magic
KOLA and other AB Volvo related system tools
Available within 1 month’s notice

Personal attributes
You have a positive and open attitude, are curious and have a drive to improve and deliver at the top. You are also a good team player who likes to achieve results both as a team, organization and individually.
About Condesign
Our team of approximately 150 dedicated consultants brings a broad range of experience from diverse industries to help our customers achieve success today and in the future. We are committed to innovation and growth and strive to provide the best possible service to our customers. Condesign is a privately owned engineering company that provides customers with high-quality services and innovative solutions throughout the entire product life cycle, from R&D and design to aftermarket. Established in 1984 in Gothenburg,
More Information
We value our employees and look positively on competence and career development. In this role, you will receive training and education in everything needed to perform the work effectively. We also train for the next career step and work continuously to identify this.
Salary is paid monthly. Competitive individual salary is applied and revised up annually. Salary is based on academic and professional merits and experience, as well as level of responsibility in the role and individual dialogue. We only have full-time positions, no internships or unpaid internships.
We are proud of our employment offer and follow the collective agreement.
A warm welcome to submit your application!
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

Are you passionate about beer, quality and production processes? Do you want to be a key player in brewing and packaging our award-winning beers? Then you might be our next Brew & Packaging Operator!
Omnipollo AB is a Swedish brewery founded in 2010 by brewer Henok Fentie and designer Karl Grandin. Over the years, the brewery has won numerous awards for its beer and exports its beer to over 40 countries. Omnipollo AB has a number of restaurants and bars including Omnipollos hatt, Omnipollos Flora, and Omnipollos kyrka in Stockholm as well as Omnipollos Tokyo in Japan.
About the Role
As a Brew & Packaging Operator, you will play a central role in our production facility in Kungsängen and in our brewery in Sundbyberg. Your main responsibility is to ensure that our beers are brewed and packaged with the highest precision and quality, whether in cans, kegs, or bottles. You will work across the entire process – from brewing, cellar work, dry hopping, transferring beer, and cleaning to packaging and logging. Together with your colleagues, you will take responsibility for creating a good working environment and developing our operations. The work is physical and requires precision for us to maintain our high routines and industry standards.
Your Responsibilities:
Brewhouse & Cellar work
Milling
Mashing
Lautering
Boiling
Chilling
Fermentation checks
Dry hopping
Tank transfers

Packaging work
Packaging beer in cans, kegs, and bottles
Centrifugation and pasteurization
Logging and documentation of work
Performing cleaning and CIP (Clean in Place).
Preparation of incoming and outgoing shipments of raw materials and finished products
Contributing to a good working environment and improving our working methods

Who Are You?
We are looking for someone who has a strong interest in beer and production processes. You are a problem solver who does not hesitate to take on challenges and find creative solutions. You have a desire to learn and work well in a team as well as independently. To succeed in this role, you also need to be thorough and responsible, as well as physically fit and able to work efficiently in a dynamic environment.
Qualifications:
Brewery technician education or equivalent
At least two years of experience working in food/beverage production, preferably in a brewery and/or packaging facility
Valid B driver's license, forklift license is a plus
Basic computer skills
Technical skills
Fluent in English (both spoken and written); proficiency in Swedish is a strong plus

About the Employment
The position is full-time with an initial six-month probationary period. You will work closely with the team in our packaging facility in Kungsängen, as well as our brewery in Sundbyberg.
We believe in warmth, professionalism, and the idea that everyone should feel at home with us. Our reach is global, but our heart is rooted locally. It is our community and collaboration that make us so successful. Want to join us on our journey?
Send your application and any questions to jobs@omnipollo.com. The application deadline is December 18 , 2026. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so the position may be filled before the closing date.
Welcome with your application - and thank you very much for your interest!
We try to respond to everyone who applies to us, but sometimes we must prioritize operational activities and cannot get to all administrative tasks. So if you haven't heard from us within two weeks, we have moved forward with other candidates.

Since 1965, Stoneridge has designed and manufactured advanced, award-winning technologies including driveline and transmission actuation systems, vision systems, emissions control systems, safety systems, and security and monitoring systems for vehicle OEMs in the commercial vehicle, automotive, off-highway and agricultural vehicle markets. We’re focused on the areas of greatest market need – both today and tomorrow. Our core products and technologies are aligned with industry megatrends including safety and security, vehicle intelligence, fuel efficiency and emissions. Join the Stoneridge Team as we continue to build upon our strong history and reputation for quality products to deliver innovative products and systems that address a need, exceed our customers’ expectations, and motivate our team.
Objective of the position
At Stoneridge in Örebro, our Production Engineering team ensures that every product leaving our production lines meets the highest standards of quality and reliability. As a Junior Test Engineer, you will work closely with experienced engineers to develop, maintain and improve the test systems used in our manufacturing processes.
This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or early-career engineer who wants to gain hands-on experience in electronics, software, automation and production technology within the automotive industry.
You'll report to the Production Engineering Manager and become part of a collaborative team where curiosity, problem-solving and continuous learning are highly valued.
What You'll Do
Support the development, maintenance and improvement of production test systems and equipment.

Assist in the introduction and validation of test solutions for new products and production lines.

Troubleshoot test equipment and support production teams in resolving technical issues.

Participate in testing, verification and evaluation of prototypes and pre-production products.

Help create and maintain test-related documentation, work instructions and training materials.

Analyze test results and production data to identify opportunities for quality and process improvements.

Collaborate with colleagues across Production, Quality, Manufacturing Engineering and R&D.

What You Bring
BSc or MSc in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Embedded Systems or a related engineering field.

Up to 3 years of relevant experience through employment, internships, thesis projects or extracurricular activities.

Basic understanding of electronics and the ability to read electrical schematics.

Interest in testing, automation, manufacturing and problem-solving.

Familiarity with programming or scripting is advantageous. Experience with LabVIEW, C#, Python or similar tools is a plus.

Knowledge of measurement equipment, electronics testing or industrial automation is beneficial.

Strong analytical skills and a willingness to learn in a technical environment.

Professional working proficiency in Swedish and English.

Meritorious qualifications

Experience from automotive, manufacturing or industrial environments.

Knowledge of vision systems, CAN communication or industrial networks.

Familiarity with data analysis tools such as Minitab or similar software.

What We Offer
You will be welcomed to a fun, diverse and inclusive workplace where our culture is built on our core values: Integrity, Customer Orientation, Teamwork, Adaptability, Accountability and Social Responsibility.
At Stoneridge, you'll have the opportunity to learn from experienced engineers while contributing to products that improve safety and efficiency in commercial vehicles worldwide. We offer a supportive environment where professional development, mentorship and continuous learning are encouraged.
This role provides an excellent foundation for a long-term engineering career within a global automotive technology company focused on innovation, safety and sustainability.

Welcome to a world, where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch!
Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 650 employees and form part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 417,000 employees worldwide.

Job Description

Collect, analyze, and visualize logistics data using analytical tools to identify improvement opportunities and support KPI follow-ups
You will be Applying industrial engineering methods, including ergonomics assessments, standardized work, process mapping and FMEA
Prepare and participate in workshops, collaborate with cross-functional teams and follow up on project activities
Support project planning, documentation, and routine administrative tasks to ensure projects stay organized and on track.

Location: on-site in our plant in Tranås, Sweden

Qualifications
What distinguishes you
Currently studying Engineering or similar (Bachelor or Master of Science)
Structured and goal oriented. With ability to work independently and approach people easily
Strong interest in manufacturing, logistics and continuous improvement
Basic knowledge of CAD software (AutoCAD or similar) is an advantage.
Knowledge in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
Good analytical skills and problem-solving mindset
Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English

Additional Information

Monetary compensation is included to support you during your internship

You gain valuable experience working within an international company with global connections

Job Description
Are you passionate about customer service, technology, and problem-solving? We are looking for a Service Desk Specialist to join Tieto Banktech's Service and Support team in Kalix, Sweden. In this role, you will help support business-critical banking and financial services used across the Nordic and European markets while delivering an outstanding customer experience.

Our solutions operate in highly regulated, high-availability environments where security, resilience, and compliance are non-negotiable. 
As a Service Desk Specialist, you will be part of our 1st line support team and serve as an important link between our customers and internal teams. You will handle and coordinate incidents and service requests, communicate with customers, collaborate with colleagues across the organization, and contribute to high-quality service delivery. 
This is a full-time, office-based position in Kalix, with close collaboration with colleagues in several international locations. 
 
When joining Tieto Banktech as a Service Desk Specialist, you will:
Monitor and manage incidents, problems, changes, service requests, and orders in our ITSM platform. 
Follow our ITIL-based processes to ensure smooth operations. 
Investigate, coordinate, and follow up on incoming tickets. 
Work closely with customers, 2nd line support, IT Operations, and Delivery Managers. 
Escalate unresolved or critical issues to the appropriate teams. 
Participate in and facilitate customer follow-ups and operational review meetings. 
Prepare service reports, operational follow-ups, presentations, and monthly customer reviews. 
Ensure agreed service levels and delivery commitments are met. 
Contribute to continuous improvements in our services, processes, and ways of working. 

 
Who we are looking for 
Experience in customer service, technical support, Service Desk, or a similar customer-facing role. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 

Experience with ITSM tools, ITIL processes, financial services, SaaS platforms, or other business-critical IT services is considered an advantage
Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken. Swedish or another Scandinavian language is an advantage. 
An interest in technology and a willingness to continuously learn. 
The ability to work both independently and as part of a team. 
 
We offer 
We offer you professional growth, meaningful projects, open culture and an outstanding work-life balance! We offer you an opportunity to create the future of a growing, fast-developing and important sector. We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge. 
We value close collaboration and a strong sense of community, and therefore this is a full-time, office-based position in Kalix. 
You will join an international environment where knowledge sharing, curiosity, continuous learning, and teamwork are part of how we work. 
 
Did we get you inspired? 
We look forward to your application! 
Interviews will be held continuously, so we encourage you to apply today! For more information or questions, please contact Talent Acquisition team recruitmentinbanking@tieto.com 
Hope to hear from you soon!
